Happy New Year !

This has been an exciting week at Accudyne Systems !  Thanks to Haas Automation, Inc., Haas Factory Outlet – A Division of Phillips Machine Tools, and A&A Machinery Moving, Inc., Accudyne Systems took delivery of a brand new HAAS VF-60/40 Vertical Machining Center.  This new equipment purchase represents a significant capital investment that will further expand our custom automation equipment manufacturing capabilities.  A 20 year-old Vertical Machining Center was retired to make space for this new and much larger machining center.
